caption: The drawing depicts a single large jug made of stoneware, with a bulbous body, a narrow neck, and a small handle attached near the top of the neck. The jug is predominantly brownish-gray in color with darker and lighter spots scattered throughout its surface, suggesting texture and shading. On the jug’s side, there is a blue painted image of a bird perched on a branch or stylized line, with feathery details highlighting the wings and tail. The background is a uniform light beige with no additional objects or decorations present. The artist’s signature is faintly visible in the bottom left corner of the drawing.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
